All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
JPokeBattle
The main class of the game.
LoadNSave
It manages the saving and loading system of the game.
MainMenu
It creates all the menus of the game and use all the others classes to make everything work.
Player
It sets up all the characteristics that a player has when playing a pokémon game, such as his pokémon squad, his nickname in the game, the choice that he make in a turn, ecc...
Pokemon
It creates an instance of a pokemon, which can be without attributes, if you just need to initialize one, or with different stats describing its characteristics.
PokeMove
It manages all the info that has a pokemon move in the game.
Turn
It manages all the calculation and checks that has to be done during a battle turn or before starting it, like the damage done, which pokemon is the faster ecc...
